facts.fact: Le Sahel states (published 27 July 2026, no event date given) that the national civil-status system is the Interior Ministry's Direction Générale de l'état civil, des migrations et des réfugiés, which the restructured WURI project is to support in computerising all communes and declaration centres and putting a new digital platform into service, with the Registre National d'Etat Civil (RNEC) as the end; the Interior Minister oversees the project.
facts.system: nouvelle plateforme digitale de gestion des faits d'état civil

facts.fact: The investments planned for civil-status computerisation and the new platform come from the restructured WURI-Niger project, which Le Sahel states is financed by the World Bank (published 27 July 2026); no domestic budget line is mentioned.
facts.system: nouvelle plateforme digitale de gestion des faits d'état civil

facts.fact: Ordonnance n°2026-21 of 22 April 2026 on the civil-status regime and its application decree n°2026-277 of 18 May 2026 were adopted with the restructured WURI project's support.
facts.system: nouvelle plateforme digitale de gestion des faits d'état civil

facts.fact: As at publication on 27 July 2026, the computerisation of all communes and declaration centres and the putting into service of a new, more sovereign digital platform for civil-status events were investments 'planned', not delivered; the document gives no date for them.
facts.system: nouvelle plateforme digitale de gestion des faits d'état civil
